status: unfunded; seeking a fiscal sponsor and a Sudanese civil-society partner; no donation route open yet

tiers.name: Running now, unfunded
includes: Registry, collectors, OCR and list parsing, standing watches, operator alerts, at the pace one volunteer and a home computer allow

tiers.name: Never offline
includes: Cloud server for collectors, hourly watch check and daily processing, with monitoring and backups; two years of hosting
Automatic notification to a watch registrant when their number appears
Clear the processing backlog once
Open-source release after a secrets and security review
Published privacy and safeguarding policies

tiers.name: Same-day registry
includes: Paid processing that keeps pace with intake (about US$540/month at current volume)
OCR for every new photo
WhatsApp and Telegram search bots
Low-data version of the site for Sudanese mobile networks
Monthly public statistics

tiers.name: People on the ground
includes: Part-time Sudanese Arabic community lead for twelve months
Verified directory of official impound yards and collection sites with a claim guide
Direct intake agreements with recovery-group admins and field platforms
Owner photo matching for cars with swapped chassis plates
Legal-aid referral path

tiers.name: An institution, not a laptop
includes: Registered non-profit with board, accounts and data-protection review
One engineer and one community lead for a year
Data-sharing agreement with the Sudan Police reporting platform and the Traffic Department
Open API and data exchange with other registries
Digital Public Good registration and an independent impact evaluation

tiers.name: Beyond Sudan
includes: Three years of sustained operation for Sudan
Deployable template for partner organisations in other conflict-affected countries
Multilingual interface and list parsers

budget_12_months_usd.line: Processing to keep pace with intake
budget_12_months_usd.basis: 90,000 posts a month at a measured US$0.006 each
about 60,000 photos a month at US$1.50 per thousand

principles: Free, always: no fee to search, register a watch or receive a lead
Alerts need an exact chassis or plate; model scores never trigger one
No private channel: we never ask for a chassis number in a direct message
Photographed documents' text is never published
Every record names its source and links to the original post
Numbers are published honestly, including zero recoveries
seeking: fiscal sponsor (Open Source Collective or equivalent)
